text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
Guess that's it for today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
choice_data_list: You were in better shape than usual.
You were in better shape than usual.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Right.
choice_data_list: Want me to treat you to dinner?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You're awfully chatty today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm eating at the cafeteria.
See ya.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian promptly turned around
and walked away briskly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tried to strike up conversations whenever I could
in order to get to know her better, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed we were still far from having a proper, natural exchange.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then one day, as I was walking toward the mall
to do some shopping—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, it's you.
choice_data_list: Are you heading out to shop, Brian?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Student council gave me some chore. Total pain.
Just on my way to the mall now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It turned out we shared the same destination. As I went to
mention it and invite her to walk together—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...She had already walked ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought we had built some trust by now, but maybe
she still wanted nothing to do with me outside of running—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What're you doing? Hurry up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You're going to the mall, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Move it, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We arrived at the mall, but...
even from afar, the store we needed looked packed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unfazed by the crowd,
Narita Brian strode right into the shop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Somehow I managed to finish my shopping, but—
before I knew it, I had lost sight of Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to find her inside, I stepped outdoors,
only to find that night had fully fallen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And yet, standing right there—

text_block_list.name: Obnoxious Guy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's Narita Brian! Dude,
I saw your race! Hey, can I grab a photo with you?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...
...Get lost.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Narita Brian was standing there.
After brushing off the young man without a second thought, she turned toward me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Finally made it. Took you long enough.
choice_data_list: I thought you'd already gone home alone...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It's dark out.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking down dark streets alone can certainly be dangerous,
but I didn't think she was the type to care about that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Just start walking already, or I'll leave you behind.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
(...Worried, huh? I wonder.
I'd like to ask myself that.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
When we got separated, the first thing that came to mind
was an image of my Trainer searching for me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I simply took it for granted
that they would be looking.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
And then... my feet stopped.
I chose to wait.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Without frustration or annoyance... I merely
waited for that familiar figure to appear.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...A sense of nostalgia bleeds into my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What is this longing?
It's almost like remembering my childhood...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You never get tired of talking to me, do you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I barely give you anything back.
Normally, people would get sick of it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That may be true. But whenever I talk to you,
you always listen without fail. And that's because—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You really are a strange one.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I'll deliver the luggage tomorrow.
See you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thank her for waiting for me.
Without another word, Narita Brian turns and heads back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It was a day that gave me a brief glimpse into
Narita Brian's clumsy sort of kindness.
